acceptance_history: single-photo design failed: one stand-in photo per seeded case left 5 of 13 severity pairs out of order and a slight case below no-damage control photos (earlier scores of the same model, R05)
photo-set sizes k=1, 3 and 5 compared on those existing scores: k=1 fails the two-tier check, k=3 and k=5 pass

criterion relaxed from the full four-level severity ladder to two tiers (moderate or worse above slight and above every no-damage control group), because the LADI v2 paper merged building-damage levels that the classifier separates poorly; the full ladder is still reported (ladder_discordant_pairs)
k=5 chosen; photos are picked by CAP volunteer labels only, never by model score

dataset.credit: Civil Air Patrol imagery; labels by CAP volunteers; dataset by MIT Lincoln Laboratory
dataset.selection: label-enriched, seed 0: up to 30 positives each of roads_damage, flooding_structures, bridges_any, flooding_any, debris_any, buildings_minor_or_greater, buildings_affected_or_greater and 40 of trees_damage, then negatives; not a population sample

honest_miss: D2 complete ranks 4th of 4 damaged cases

model.role: reference model: trained on the 2015-2022 train split only, never saw 2023 test events

runtime.input: 1800x1200 JPEG through the model's AutoImageProcessor, batch size 1
